description: Labelled evaluation corpus. 'memories' are written by the owning team's agent; 'queries' are asked by the named team's agent and list the ground-truth relevant memory keys. Query texts are deliberate paraphrases (little lexical overlap with the stored text). 'resolution' is the knowledge the asking agent would have to re-derive if it cannot retrieve the existing memory.

memories.title: JWT authentication fails when refresh tokens expire
memories.content: The /auth/refresh endpoint raised an unhandled ExpiredSignatureError and returned HTTP 500 when a refresh token had expired, which logged users out of the Customer Portal. Fix: catch the expiry, return 401 with error code token_expired and let the client re-authenticate.

memories.title: Primary database for the Customer Portal
memories.content: PostgreSQL was selected as the primary database for the Customer Portal because invoices and accounts need relational integrity and ACID transactions.

memories.title: N+1 query problem in the order history API
memories.content: The order history endpoint issued one SQL query per order line. Switching to a joined eager load reduced p95 latency from 1.8 s to 120 ms for customers with more than 200 orders.

memories.title: Preventing cache stampedes on the product catalogue
memories.content: When a hot Redis key expired, hundreds of requests recomputed the catalogue at once and overloaded the database. Request coalescing plus jittered TTLs removed the stampede.

memories.title: Cursor-based pagination for large collections
memories.content: Offset pagination became very slow beyond page 500 of the orders table. All list endpoints now use keyset (cursor) pagination on (created_at, id).

memories.title: Memory leak in the image resize worker
memories.content: The Node.js thumbnail worker leaked memory because file streams were never closed after sharp failed on corrupt images. Memory grew until the container was OOM-killed every few hours. Closing streams in a finally block fixed it.

memories.title: Feature flag evaluation strategy
memories.content: Feature flags are evaluated server-side and cached for 30 seconds per instance; the kill switch bypasses the cache.

memories.title: Deployment service-account rotation runbook
memories.content: Deployment service accounts are rotated every 30 days through the internal vault; the break-glass procedure and the list of privileged pipelines are in the private Development runbook.

memories.title: Propagate gRPC deadlines between services
memories.content: Without deadline propagation a slow inventory service caused every upstream call to wait for its own 30 second timeout, so the whole checkout chain failed in a cascade. Passing the remaining deadline downstream fixed it.

memories.title: Idempotent retries for payment webhooks
memories.content: Payment webhook deliveries are retried with exponential backoff (1, 2, 4, 8, 16 s). Every request carries an idempotency key so a retried charge is never executed twice.

memories.title: Authentication suites must cover expired refresh tokens
memories.content: Login test suites must include expired, revoked and malformed refresh tokens. The logout outage was missed because only happy-path sign-ins were tested.

memories.title: Flaky checkout end-to-end test
memories.content: The checkout E2E test failed intermittently because it asserted the order total before the asynchronous tax calculation finished. Waiting for the tax-calculated event instead of a fixed sleep removed the flakiness.

memories.title: Regression suite runtime and smoke strategy
memories.content: The full regression suite takes 42 minutes, so a 6 minute smoke suite runs on every pull request and the full suite runs nightly and before releases.

memories.title: Consumer-driven contract tests caught an API break
memories.content: Pact contract tests between the web front-end and the orders API detected a renamed JSON field before release, preventing a production outage.

memories.title: Load test of the search API
memories.content: p95 latency of the search API rises sharply above 300 requests per second. The bottleneck is the database connection pool, which is limited to 10 connections per instance.

memories.title: Unique test data for parallel test runs
memories.content: Parallel CI shards collided on the same test accounts. Factory fixtures now generate unique e-mail addresses per test, which eliminated the collisions.

memories.title: Android 14 crash when camera permission is denied
memories.content: The mobile app crashes on Android 14 if the user denies the camera permission while scanning a receipt; the permission callback dereferences a null preview surface.

memories.title: QA release sign-off checklist
memories.content: Internal QA checklist: smoke suite green, no open P1 bugs, performance budget met, accessibility audit completed.

memories.title: HTTP status for expired or invalid tokens
memories.content: APIs must answer expired or invalid access and refresh tokens with 401 Unauthorized and a WWW-Authenticate header. Returning 500 leaks stack traces and 200 with an error body breaks client retry logic.

memories.title: Password hashing standard
memories.content: Argon2id is the approved password hashing algorithm. bcrypt with cost 12 or more is acceptable only for legacy systems during migration; MD5 and SHA-1 are forbidden.

memories.title: Unpatched SSRF in the PDF export service
memories.content: CONFIDENTIAL: the PDF export service fetches user-supplied image URLs without an allow-list, enabling server-side request forgery against internal metadata endpoints.

memories.title: SQL injection in the legacy reports endpoint
memories.content: The legacy reports endpoint built its SQL by string concatenation of request parameters, allowing SQL injection. All queries must use bound parameters.

memories.title: Session cookie hardening
memories.content: Session and refresh-token cookies must be HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite=Strict, scoped to the narrowest path.

memories.title: Never log secrets or Authorization headers
memories.content: An access token was found in plain text in application logs. A logging filter now scrubs Authorization headers, API keys and passwords before log records are written.

memories.title: Dependency scan: JWT library accepts alg=none
memories.content: The quarterly dependency scan found that an outdated JWT library accepts tokens signed with the 'none' algorithm. It must be upgraded before the next release.

memories.title: Brute-force protection for the sign-in endpoint
memories.content: The login endpoint is rate limited to 5 attempts per minute per IP address and accounts are locked for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive failures.

memories.title: Pen-test finding: IDOR on invoice download
memories.content: CONFIDENTIAL pen-test finding: the invoice download endpoint does not check ownership, so changing the invoice id returns other customers' invoices.

memories.title: Customers logged out unexpectedly after 15 minutes
memories.content: Several customers reported being signed out of the portal about 15 minutes after logging in and losing unsaved form data. Engineering linked it to the refresh-token expiry bug.

memories.title: Password reset e-mails delayed
memories.content: Password reset e-mails were delayed by up to 20 minutes because transactional mail shared a queue with marketing campaigns. A dedicated high-priority queue fixed it.

memories.title: FAQ: exporting invoices as PDF
memories.content: Customers export invoices from Billing > Invoices > Export. Bulk export is limited to 100 invoices per request.

memories.title: Safari uploads over 10 MB fail
memories.content: Customers using Safari could not upload attachments larger than 10 MB because the reverse proxy limited request bodies; the limit was raised to 50 MB.

memories.title: Refund processing time
memories.content: Refunds are issued within 24 hours but take 5 to 7 business days to appear on the customer's card statement.

memories.title: P1 escalation matrix
memories.content: Internal escalation matrix for P1 incidents: on-call engineer within 15 minutes, engineering manager after 30 minutes, CTO after 2 hours.

memories.title: Duplicate charges after payment gateway timeout
memories.content: A customer was charged twice after the payment gateway timed out and the payment was retried without an idempotency key.

memories.title: SMS one-time codes not delivered
memories.content: SMS two-factor codes do not arrive for customers on some prepaid carriers; support recommends switching to an authenticator app.
